name: Zhejiang Qianjiang Motorcycle Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Qianjiang Motorcycle Co., Ltd. researches and develops, manufactures, sells, and services motorcycles and accessories in China and internationally. It provides electric and ATV/UTV, SSVs, and snowmobiles models. The company also offers street bikes, sport bikes, cruisers, retro bikes, adventure bikes, off-road bikes, and scooters. The company offers its products under the QJmotor, Qianjiang, and Benelli brand names. Zhejiang Qianjiang Motorcycle Co., Ltd. was founded in 1985 and is based in Taizhou, China.
